verdicts.decision_note: The client accepts replacing the data-line-deficient connector with a standard, readily obtainable USB-C connector, affecting connector capability and component selection.
The client makes compatible replacement availability an acceptance condition for selecting the proposed USB-C connector; overwriting the existing sourceability attribute leaves no stale key.

Neither the source nor the supplied adjacent context unambiguously identifies the discussed part as the power-board USB-C connector, so the sourcing exception cannot be safely routed to this Requirement.
This exchange concerns connector placement on the later integrated board, not the power-board USB-C connector's capability or sourceability.

missing_event_candidates.description: The exchange establishes integrated-board connector-placement constraints and accepts placement along three sides, subject to the battery, USB-C, display-flex, and antenna-layout constraints.
